meaning: explanatory: it's that ~ / the thing is ~
notes: prototype-ids.tsv files this at N3, but every checked source lists it at N5. jlptsensei lists んです and のです as two entries; merged. Sentence-final の in questions is a separate entry (no-question); the matcher must tell explanatory の from possessive and nominalizer の.

meaning: ongoing action, resulting state, or habit
notes: Bunpro splits it into three points (progressive, state, habitual); merged here. jlptsensei and marumori list 〜ていた (past continuous) separately at N4; kept as a variant here, decide later whether it needs its own entry.

Classified as construction because all sources treat it as a clause-linking reason. Same surface as kara-from (particle); the matcher must check that から follows a predicate, not a noun. Sentence-initial だから is a conjunction word, not in any N5 list.

jlptsensei and bunpro list けど and けれども as two points; merged as spelling variants. marumori lists けど at N5 but けれども at N4. Clause-linking, so construction. Also softens a sentence-final clause (言ったけど…).
jlptsensei folds it into the が entry with the subject marker; split here because it links clauses. marumori lists （です・だ）が at N4. Must not be confused with ga-subject: this が follows a predicate.

jlptsensei and bunpro list でしょう and だろう separately; merged as polite/plain pair. Bunpro lists のだろうか at N4 and marumori lists (の)でしょうか at N4 as 'I wonder'; that wondering use may need its own entry at N4.
Third-person 〜たがる is N4 (prototype tagaru).
Noun + をください is a separate entry (o-kudasai). Negative ないでください is naide-kudasai.
Bunpro also lists がある + Noun (a noun that has ~) at N5; folded in here. Overlaps with ta-koto-ga-aru, which ends in the same verb.
The same verb いる is the auxiliary in te-iru; the matcher must not count 〜ている as existence.

meaning: because ~ / since ~ (softer, more objective than から)
notes: prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but all five checked sources list it at N5. Clause-linking, so construction. Casual んで collides with explanatory ん + て; flag for the matcher.
〜ましょうか (offer or suggestion as a question) is a separate entry, mashou-ka. A matcher for mashou must not also fire on ましょうか, or the two entries must be kept apart explicitly.

meaning: it's okay to do ~ / may I do ~?
notes: marumori bundles it with concessive 〜ても (even if); jlptsensei and bunpro put bare 〜ても at N4, so concessive ても is left out of this file. てもかまわない is N3 in bunpro; listed as a variant only for recognition, may move. Negative なくてもいい is nakute-mo-ii.
Spatial 'in front of' (Nの前) is covered by no-position. Time span + 前 (三年前, 'ago') is a word use, not this pattern; tanos's gloss mentions 'ago'.
Non-past 〜ることがある ('there are times when') is N4 in jlptsensei and marumori; the matcher must require the past た before こと.
